bio: I am a joint PhD student (2023–2027, expected) working on the Food–Water–Ecosystem (F–W–E) nexus in China.
My research integrates remote sensing, LUCC-related products and spatial statistics to understand how agricultural changes affect water and ecosystem.

news.text: One paper accepted in Journal of Hydrology.
One paper accepted in Geography and Sustainability.
Contributed to the UN SDG Big Earth Data Report 2024.
